name: Abiraterone
route_note: oral tablets of abiraterone acetate once daily on an empty stomach, with prednisone or prednisolone
originator: Institute of Cancer Research, London (Gerry Potter, Michael Jarman, Mike Rowlands); developed by BTG, Cougar Biotechnology and Janssen

discovery.by: Gerry Potter and colleagues, Institute of Cancer Research
discovery.note: A steroidal pyridine designed as an irreversible inhibitor of 17α-hydroxylase/C17,20-lyase to block androgen synthesis in testes, adrenals and tumour.

tagline: Androgen synthesis inhibitor developed at London's Institute of Cancer Research
summary: Abiraterone acetate is a prodrug of abiraterone, which inhibits CYP17A1 and shuts down androgen production in the testes, adrenal glands and prostate tumour tissue. Taken with prednisone, it prolongs survival in metastatic castration-resistant and high-risk castration-sensitive prostate cancer.
mechanism: CYP17A1 catalyses both 17α-hydroxylase and 17,20-lyase reactions needed to make dehydroepiandrosterone and androstenedione, the precursors of testosterone.

Abiraterone irreversibly inhibits CYP17A1, reducing serum testosterone to undetectable levels even in castrated men. Blocking 17α-hydroxylation lowers cortisol and raises ACTH, which increases mineralocorticoids and causes hypertension, hypokalaemia and fluid retention; low-dose prednisone is given to suppress ACTH.
uses: Combination with niraparib or olaparib in BRCA-mutated mCRPC

history.title: Discovery
history.detail: Synthesised at the Institute of Cancer Research.

history.title: Licensing
history.detail: BTG licenses the compound to Cougar Biotechnology.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: COU-AA-301 shows a survival gain after docetaxel; approved as Zytiga.

history.title: Chemotherapy-naive
history.detail: COU-AA-302 leads to approval before chemotherapy.

history.title: LATITUDE and STAMPEDE
history.detail: Abiraterone added to androgen deprivation improves survival in hormone-sensitive disease; FDA approval in 2018.

history.title: Generics
history.detail: First US generic abiraterone launches after patent litigation.

history.title: Akeega
history.detail: FDA approves niraparib–abiraterone fixed-dose combination for BRCA-mutated mCRPC.

pk.bioavailability: low and highly food-dependent (exposure rises up to 10-fold with a high-fat meal)

serious: increased fractures and mortality with radium-223

facts: It is a notable example of an academic UK cancer drug whose royalties returned to the Institute of Cancer Research.
